cases.accepted_boundary: Only an unstable provider client remains at death; earlier cursors/PFDs are closed. Native signature-protected witness proves provider PID/generation; acknowledged actual self-kill/Binder death; stale.query raises actual DeadObjectException. Reporter survives; public metadata and exact survivor bytes recover under new provider PID/generation with close1/FD0. This does not diagnose the historical signal-9 or establish permanent-provider-unavailability handling.
cases.name: ownedProviderDeathProducesRealBinderFailureAndTreeMetadataRecovers

cases.accepted_boundary: Actual production KmpFileFetcher/Coil ImageLoader/Okio source using explicitly injected decoder IOException. Actual octet MIME/DISK source, non-main Looper, positive REG FD before/after EOF, full binary parity, preserved injected origin, one remote source close, zero closeErrors/writes and real client FD0. No default bitmap decoder, EXIF, seek or memory benchmark.
cases.name: nativeCoilDecoderFailureClosesCrossUidSourceAfterExactBinaryRead

cases.accepted_boundary: Real Android read-only/persistable/prefix Activity-result tree permission; public bookmark stored with SharedPreferences.commit; acknowledged owned secondary client process kill/Binder death; different PID/generation, persisted read and metadata/content after reconnect; public release removes access and actual read raises SecurityException. Reporter remains alive; no reboot or whole-app restart.
cases.name: persistedTreeBookmarkSurvivesOwnedClientRestartAndExplicitRelease

cases.accepted_boundary: Actual Coil source with explicitly injected paused decoder reads the first real byte. Positive REG FD and close0 before cancel; actual coroutine cancelAndJoin, cancelled job/no late success, remote close1, zero writes/closeErrors and real client FD0; joined job/ImageLoader shutdown in failure-safe finally. No bitmap/cancellation-at-all-stages inference.
cases.name: nativeCoilCancellationClosesTransferredSourceWithoutLateSuccess

cases.accepted_boundary: Public fixed tree and child metadata, four child IDs and exact byte payload; real source-owner revokeUriPermission; denied URI permission/fromBookmark/metadata and actual SecurityException on read; refused access leaves opens/closes at one. Not a system/cloud provider.
cases.name: ownerRevocationDeniesTreeAndChildMetadataAndActualContentRead

scope: Five accepted actual API35 fixed-fixture method executions only; future reuse requires exact applicable source/runtime review, not replay or five additional suite passes.
